title: Log the two silent catch blocks in lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart via AppLogger
why: Both catches swallow every exception with no AppLogger call. If programCalendarPositionProvider throws (line 430-431), overdueCount/todayDueCount silently become 0 — a falsely reassuring 'nothing overdue' on the dashboard per-track row — with zero breadcrumb to diagnose it. If getScopedContent throws inside _safeLoadLeavesForTrack (line 648), the track just vanishes from trackDualProgressMetricsProvider's output with no trace. The same file already fixes this exact anti-pattern under the F20 label for _safeLoadLeaves/_safeHeLabelLookup (lines ~570-609, which log via AppLogger.warning with event/fields/exception/stackTrace) — these two catches were never brought in line with that established, documented convention.
recommendation: Log both catches via AppLogger.warning(event:, exception:, stackTrace:) before falling back, matching the F20 pattern used elsewhere in the same file.
acceptance_criteria: Both catch blocks call AppLogger before returning/defaulting
No 'catch (_) {' block in lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart lacks an adjacent AppLogger call
mergedFrom: Log the 5 silent catch blocks in items_learned_providers.dart and lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart (EH-3 log-less catch)
